title: Safety Rail Controller for live batching and cache policy adjustments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement a Safety Rail Controller (SRC) that coordinates automated batching and KV-cache configuration suggestions with enforced latency and throughput guardrails. The SRC must be able to propose changes, simulate expected effects, apply safe deltas, monitor the live impact against latency/throughput SLOs, and trigger automatic rollback or progressive mitigation (throttles, SLO-aware routing) on anomalies. This ticket covers controller orchestration, limiter primitives, SLO-aware routing policies, anomaly detection thresholds, and the safe apply/rollback flow integrated with the Console and runtime metrics.
acceptance_criteria: SRC can ingest a recommended batching/cache profile and produce a planned delta with estimated cost/latency impact
Live apply supports atomic partial rollouts (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with configurable escalation windows
Realtime monitors evaluate latency p50/p95/p99 and throughput against configured SLOs and trigger rollback on sustained violation per policy
SLO-aware router can divert traffic to fallback model variants (lower batch size or smaller quantized model) based on guardrail decisions
Console shows audit trail, per-rollout telemetry, and one-click manual rollback in <30s
Safety tests (integration) exercise an induced latency spike and validate controller triggers mitigations automatically

notes: Trade-offs considered: aggressive batching reduces unit cost but increases tail latency; SRC will bias towards preserving p95/p99 at cost of slower rollouts when SLO headroom is low.
Mitigation primitives: immediate rollback, throttling (reduce concurrency), SLO-aware routing to cheaper model variant, partial traffic percentage rollbacks.
Operational playbook will be added to runbook repo (link to be added) describing manual rollback steps and investigation checklist.
We will instrument token-level accounting to correlate cost savings with latency regressions for postmortem analysis.
